shop.eyebrow: Printed to order, in Gland and Pully
shop.title: Shop.
shop.emptyCatalog: No items in the shop right now. Customise your own in the Studio or send us a file.

studio.title: To customise in the Studio.
studio.intro: Four objects designed by the workshop that you customise in 3D before sending them to us. They are not shop items: the firm price is confirmed on quote within 48 hours.

lavaux.name: "Lavaux" vase
lavaux.line: A vase from 80 to 240 mm: shape, pattern, up to four color bands.

cartouche.name: "Cartouche" business card
cartouche.line: An 85 × 55 mm business card, your name embossed or engraved.

relief.name: "Relief" coaster
relief.line: A topographic coaster from 90 to 110 mm, with your peak in relief.

borne.name: "Borne" name tag
borne.line: A two-color name tag, embossed or engraved, with or without a ring.

file.title: Already have a file?
file.text: STL, 3MF, OBJ or STEP: send it, the workshop replies within 48 hours with a quote.

attribution.body: Design: {author}, "{title}", published on {platform}. License Creative Commons BY-ND 4.0. Swiss3Design prints this model without any modification. This credit does not imply any endorsement of Swiss3Design by the author.

viewer.caption: Real-time render of {author}'s original file, unmodified.
viewer.poster: Photo of the printed piece. The 3D preview replaces it as soon as it is ready (WebGL required).
viewer.ready: 3D model ready. Left and right arrow keys rotate it.
viewer.error: 3D preview unavailable. The photo of the piece stays in place.
viewer.label: 3D preview of {name}: arrow keys to rotate

cross.title: A vase in your colors?
cross.body: This vase stays exactly as {author} drew it. For a vase in your colors, the Studio offers our own parametric models.
